fields.statement: Verifier at 77cd67581: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./tools/release/... passes (TestLatestVersion, TestLatestVersionOrdering, TestGitLatestVersion); go vet and gofmt clean. TestGitLatestVersion builds a hermetic repo and computes v0.0.1-main.2+sha with no tag, v0.3.0 with the tag at HEAD, and v0.3.1-main.2+sha with the tag 2 commits back. The test's semverLess orders v0.1.0 < v0.1.1-main.3 < main.4 < main.10 < v0.1.1. Cross-checked independently with golang.org/x/mod/semver v0.37.0: all those versions are valid semver and Compare gives the same order (also v0.0.0 < v0.0.1-main.12+abc1234 < v0.0.1). go run ./tools/release version on this checkout printed v0.0.1-main.477+77cd675. Diff read: version.go formats vX.Y.(Z+1)-main.N+<7-char sha> from git describe --match v*.*.* and rev-list --count.
